items.title: Only four directs
items.description: You sponsor exactly four people. Once those seats are filled, your personal invite work is done — the matrix does the rest.

items.description: Climb SMART → MASTER → STAR → SUPER STAR → CROWN → DOUBLE CROWN with cash and real products as each generation fills.

items.title: Two starter kits
items.description: Choose Package A or B for the same ₹2,500 entry. Same reward ladder — pick the kit that fits your household.

items.title: Live team tree
items.description: Watch your network grow in real time. See who sits where, who activated, and how close you are to the next level.

items.title: Wallet-ready payouts
items.description: Rewards land in your wallet. Finish KYC, add your bank, and withdraw when you are ready.
